summary: Rockwell requires the survivor to handle tentacles and exposed-heart phases. A strong tame army does not replace phase control.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.

steps.title: 1 · Underground survival
steps.reason: Prepare charge light, spare hazard equipment and reliable transport before descending into dangerous regions.

steps.title: 2 · Artifacts and combat kit
steps.reason: Collect Depths, Shadows and Stalker. Check the terminal tribute and organize ammunition, Medical Brew and spare armor.

steps.title: 3 · Rockwell: tentacles → heart → repeat
steps.reason: Destroy tentacles to open the heart phase; stay mobile and control pressure from adds and orbs. Assign a clear role to every tame.

loadouts.entry: Check current ASA tribute and creature eligibility at the terminal before committing your team.
loadouts.warning: Cactus-broth or no-tame cheese from ASE is not verified for the current ASA patch.

options.title: Survivor phase control + supporting tames
options.team: The survivor handles tentacles and heart; select supporting tames only after checking ASA arena eligibility.
options.why: Phase control determines progress. This is a preparation plan rather than a measured Alpha army.
options.play: Practice aiming, reloads and movement at Gamma. Separate whistle groups so you can command tames while shooting.
options.confidence: Suggested phase-control preparation; current ASA solo army and stat thresholds are not verified.

sources.title: Wildcard · Aberration Ascended
sources.note: Confirms the ASA expansion. This plan does not copy ASE stat requirements.
